title: Image of the third Johnson homomorphism
summary: In this note we show that the image of the third Johnson homomorphism $τ_3$ coincides with the kernel of Morita's trace map for the case of a surface of genus $g$ with one boundary component $Σ_{g,1}$, when $g \geq 6$. Moreover, as a consequence, we get that the image of $τ_3$ on the handlebody subgroups coincides with the intersection of kernels of the Morita trace map and the Lagrangian trace maps.
